title: Tic Tac Toe
seoTitle: Tic Tac Toe – Play Online vs Computer or 2 Players
description: Play Tic Tac Toe online for free against the computer (Easy, Medium or unbeatable Hard) or with a friend on the same device. Quick rounds, no download.
tagline: Three in a row wins. Can you beat Hard mode?
controls: Place on a square (1 is top left)
lede: Noughts and crosses against a computer with three difficulty levels, or against a friend on the same screen. Hard mode never loses, so a draw is a win.

p: Players take turns placing their mark, X or O, on a 3×3 grid. The first to get three in a row across, down or diagonally wins. If all nine squares fill up without a line, the round is a draw.
In this version you are X against the computer. The first move switches every round, so sometimes the computer starts.
Perfect Tic Tac Toe always ends in a draw. To play perfectly, go down this list on every move and take the first one that applies:
ol: Win: if you have two in a row and the third square is free, take it.
Block: if your opponent has two in a row, take the third square.
Fork: make a move that creates two lines of two at once. Only one can be blocked.
Block a fork: if your opponent can fork next turn, stop it, ideally by making two in a row yourself so they have to answer.
If your opponent is in a corner, take the opposite corner.

dl: Mostly random. It sometimes spots a winning move and rarely blocks yours. Good for learning or for young players.
Takes a win when it sees one and usually blocks your lines, but it can be caught out by a fork.
Looks at every possible game before it moves, so it never loses. Your goal is a draw.

p: Three-in-a-row games have been played for a long time. People in the Roman Empire played a version called terni lapilli, and in Britain the game is still called noughts and crosses.
In 1952 a version called OXO was programmed on the EDSAC computer at the University of Cambridge. It is one of the earliest video games.

For another game to play with a friend on one screen, try [[rock-paper-scissors]] or take turns in [[memory-match]]. More games for two are in [[cat:two-player|2 player games]], and more thinking games in [[cat:strategy|strategy games]].

faq: How do I play with a friend?
Open the options under the board and choose 2 Players. You take turns on the same device: X first, then O.
What is the best first move?
The centre, followed by a corner. Both give you the most ways to make three in a row.
Yes. Wins, losses and draws are counted on your device, separately for each mode and difficulty.
